events.name: Mayor's Charity Reception + Rêverie: The Life and Loves of Debussy
events.description: Mayor’s charity reception begins at 6:15pm at Castle Lodge, followed by front-row seats for Rêverie: The Life and Loves of Debussy at 7:30pm at Ludlow Assembly Rooms. Tickets are £40 per person, with proceeds supporting St Michael’s Hospice and Working Together Ludlow.

events.name: October Half Term Urban Games – Telford & Wrekin
events.description: Free October half-term Urban Games run from 26–30 October across the Telford & Wrekin area. Sessions are 12:00–13:30 or 14:00–15:30. No booking is required; participants can turn up and join in.

events.name: Wellington Halloween Trail 2026
events.description: A free Halloween trail around Wellington town centre for children and families, with clues and Halloween-themed displays to discover. The official Town Council listing says successful completion is rewarded. The published calendar gives an overall event window from 24 October at 08:00 to 31 October at 17:00.

events.name: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie (U)
events.description: Family cinema screening of PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie, certificate U. The venue lists an approximate running time of 98 minutes including adverts. Tickets: adult £8, child under 12 £6, Friends £7.
events.accessibility: CEA cards are accepted for film screenings. Wheelchair-space and CEA-card bookings cannot be made online and should be arranged with the box office.
events.age_guidance: U certificate; child ticket applies to under 12s

events.name: Free Halloween Craft Drop-ins – Shrewsbury Flaxmill Maltings
events.description: Free drop-in Halloween craft sessions on Thursday 29, Friday 30 and Saturday 31 October, 10am–2pm each day. Children can make haunted decorations such as spiral spooks, spiders or rats. No admission purchase or booking is needed for the free craft activities. A separate Rat Trail runs during half term and normal exhibition prices apply to that trail.
events.age_guidance: Ages 2–12; older siblings welcome; adult accompaniment required

events.name: YOUNG FRANKENSTEIN – Free Film Wednesday
events.description: Free Film Wednesday screening of the 1974 comedy Young Frankenstein. Doors open 1:30pm; film starts 2pm; runtime 1h46m; light refreshments available.

events.name: Mayor of Ludlow’s Masquerade Gala Dinner
events.description: Mayor of Ludlow charity gala with a complimentary welcome drink, two-course dinner by Chapter 66, drinks from Tipsy Toms and a fundraising raffle. Masks are optional.

events.name: Reuse Pop-up Event
events.venue: Unit 501 Queensway Business Park, Hadley Park
events.description: Telford & Wrekin Council reuse sale offering good-quality household goods at low prices. Cash only; items must be taken away before closing; event may close early if sold out; dogs are not permitted.
events.parking_transport: Parking available next to the premises; use lined bays. Council advises considering car sharing because the site can get busy.

events.name: Ska Night
events.description: Ska, 2 Tone, reggae, 60s Mod and Weller night with DJs Russ & Sarah and guest DJ Scott Picken. Licensed bar.

events.name: The Magic of the Musicals
events.description: Musical-theatre tribute featuring professional vocalists Paul (Tom Wenlock) and Becky (Becca Gee Singer), with songs from productions including Phantom of the Opera and Mamma Mia.

events.name: What’s your poison? A Halloween Quiz
events.description: Halloween quiz themed around poisonous plants and malevolent medics, led by the ghostly Dr Withering character. £2 per player; maximum six players per team.

events.name: Carer’s Café
events.description: Free activity and social group for carers, with hands-on activities including STEM, crafts and aviation experiences plus a cuppa and biscuits. No booking required.

events.name: Future Battlefield Innovation Conference
events.description: In-person conference organised by the British Commission for Military History and hosted by RAF Museum Midlands, exploring technological and geopolitical change in future battlefields. Programme includes drones, cyber-warfare, AI, historical lessons and a keynote from the RAF Director of Defence Studies. Ticket includes coffee and lunch.

events.name: Battle of the Bands: Heat Three
events.description: Third heat of Albert’s Shed Southwater’s grassroots Battle of the Bands competition for emerging original bands from Telford and the surrounding area. Four bands take part and audience voting contributes to the result. Official FAQ says the heats are planned as free-entry events.

events.name: Meet the Artists: ReMix & Textile 21
events.description: Joint Meet the Artists day for the ReMix exhibition 'Arrivals and Departures' and Textile 21 exhibition 'The Discerning Palette'.

events.name: Carer’s Café Social
events.description: Relaxed social group for carers to meet and chat in the Visitor Centre overlooking the airfield. Visitors buy their own cuppa and the museum provides biscuits; no booking required.
events.parking_transport: Free parking is provided for this event.
